1.text: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah] –

2.text: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city –

3.text: And [by] the father<sup foot_note="228236">1</sup> and that which was born [of him],

footnotes.228236: - Said to be Adam (upon him be peace) .

4.text: We have certainly created man into hardship.

5.text: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

6.text: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

7.text: Does he think that no one has seen him?

8.text: Have We not made for him two eyes?

9.text: And a tongue and two lips?

10.text: And have shown him the two ways?<sup foot_note="228237">1</sup>

11.text: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.<sup foot_note="228238">1</sup>

footnotes.228238: - i.e., the steep incline or obstacle. In other words, he has not spent in the cause of Allāh but only boasts of spending in front of others.

12.text: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

13.text: It is the freeing of a slave

14.text: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

16.text: Or a needy person in misery

17.text: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

18.text: Those are the companions of the right.<sup foot_note="228239">1</sup>

footnotes.228239: - Or "the companions of good fortune," i.e., those who receive their records in their right hands and proceed to Paradise.

19.text: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.<sup foot_note="228240">1</sup>

footnotes.228240: - Or "the companions of ill fortune," i.e., those who receive their records in their left hands and proceed to Hell.

20.text: Over them will be fire closed in.<sup foot_note="228241">1</sup>

footnotes.228241: - The cover over Hell will be sealed and locked, containing its fire and its inhabitants.
